rive.about: Control data for the live Spark Rive character, kept inside the Lottie (players ignore this key). Frames are player frames: 0 = the Lottie's first frame (comp frame 20). track.spark[frame] = [centerX, centerY, scalePercent, rotationDeg, opacity] in the 1920x1080 comp; it is the same as the Spark placeholder layer. Everything else (Vyom, the Goal icon, the trail, ...) is drawn by the Lottie itself.
